title: Primakov proposes that the SVR keep Arafat alive and the CIA keep Rabin alive

tellings.quote: >> "Our goal will be to keep Arafat alive. Your goal will be to keep Rabin alive."

plain: In Moscow in 1993, the head of Russia's foreign spy service, the SVR, a man named Yevgeny Primakov, is said to have offered the CIA a deal to protect the Middle East peace process. Russia's spies would keep the Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat alive, and America's spies would keep the Israeli prime minister Yitzhak Rabin alive: "Our goal will be to keep Arafat alive. Your goal will be to keep Rabin alive." A former senior CIA officer named Rolf Mowatt-Larssen tells this as something Primakov said to him directly. If it is true, it shows two rival spy services quietly working side by side.
